segments.name: Specialty Finance
segments.description: Provides senior secured loans and Structured Debt to venture capital-backed and institutional-backed technology and life sciences companies.
segments.evidence: Hercules Capital, Inc. is a specialty finance company focused on providing senior secured loans to high-growth, innovative venture capital-backed and institutional-backed companies in a variety of technology and life sciences industries.

revenueModel.text: Portfolio companies pay interest and fees on debt investments, and the company earns capital appreciation from warrant and equity investments plus management fees from third-party funds.
revenueModel.evidence: We aim to achieve our business objectives by maximizing our portfolio total return through generation of current income from our debt investments and capital appreciation from our warrant and equity investments.
